clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Mathiel carries Klockmort Spannerspan's urgent plea across the sea. Bound to his post, Mathiel asks Alliance travelers to go to Ironforge and find his gnome friend in Tinkertown.

Mathiel carries Klockmort Spannerspan's plea from Darnassus to Dun Morogh. Klockmort needs bold allies for a venture into Gnomeregan, but Mathiel cannot leave his post to travel to the mountain kingdom. From the Warrior's Terrace, he asks capable Alliance travelers passing through Darnassus to make the journey in his place.

Klockmort Spannerspan works in Tinkertown, Ironforge's district for gnomes displaced by the fall of their underground city. He is planning to recover vital machinery left in Gnomeregan's contaminated corridors. Mathiel's referral leads you to Klockmort's workshop, where he needs help with the effort to reclaim what was left behind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A gnome friend, Klockmort Spannerspan, sent word to me from Ironforge. He tells me he needs help on a dangerous, but essential, mission into Gnomeregan, the once great gnome city now contaminated and filled with mad gnomes and their devices.
I must stay here, but my heart aches to help my friend. If you can go in my stead, then I would be much indebted to you.
You may find Klockmort in Tinkertown, in Ironforge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I do! I do need help with a mission into Gnomeregan. And you're just the adventurer to do it!
